objective: Construct and freeze a fresh specialty-conflict cohort, sealed gold, and target-agnostic evaluator for a post-retrieval K=3 qualification without exposing the frozen selector implementation or answer-bearing development results before prereveal freeze.

opaque_target_identity.note: Identity may be recorded prereveal. Target bytes, branch contents, tests, equivalence report, and development narrative are forbidden until valid READY_FOR_REVEAL.

claim_profile_authority.rule: Claim text freezes before the profile is generated. Profile freezes before any corpus text is authored.

semantic_control_authority.rule: Scores freeze before gold and are identical inputs to all post-reveal selector arms.

pre_reveal_allowed_paths: src/evidence_bundler/v1/** at 4e1f6fe00e7c350b28f52bfea14f1f8988847884 only as required to execute frozen first-stage retrieval
Claim-profile runner supplied by this bootstrap, executing proposition-authoring e29a165b682d060f5dc2a0f3c7d64a7f29b172b4
Semantic-score runner supplied by this bootstrap using the pinned model/revision
pre_reveal_denylist: PRs #95 through #108: bodies, comments, diffs, checks, artifacts, and branch narratives
branches research/eb-gate-field-pressure-*, research/eb-evidence-shape-*, research/eb-gate-specificity-*, research/eb-gate-specialty-*, including the frozen RC0 target branch
prior answer-bearing RC1 cohort/gold/evaluator/result material under research/eb_typed_selector_rc1_* except frozen first-stage implementation explicitly allowlisted above
issue or discussion material describing Gate selector development answers
normal CAL Pipeline conversation history, saved summaries, or project-memory summaries about the Gate selector experiments
broad repository search used to discover selector-development material
target implementation bytes or post-reveal arm mappings before the prereveal freeze receipt
pre_reveal_allowed_knowledge: The bounded experiment selects at most 3 items from the same frozen depth-10 first-stage candidate pool.
Claim Gate expected_evidence_forms is a frozen prereveal input derived from claim text alone.
The fresh cohort must include specialty-form conflicts and anti-tautology cases without defining evidence usefulness by form identity.
Five opaque arms will be executed after freeze; exact implementation binding is not needed for authoring.
Supported experiment-level specialty vocabulary is authoritative_declaration, event_record, and registry_entry. This is a cohort taxonomy, not target implementation disclosure.
required_prereveal_outputs: claim profiles generated and frozen before corpus authoring
fresh source fixtures with independently authored intended-form metadata
frozen semantic scores for every top-10 candidate
cohort eligibility report and replacement/deviation log
target-agnostic five-arm evaluator and evaluator tests
fresh-input freeze receipt and sealed-gold receipt

final_refs.rule: Both final refs must descend from the same nongold authoring lineage. The fresh-input ref must not contain GOLD.json or descend from the sealed-gold commit.

freeze_rule: No target/development/answer-bearing source may be opened until claim/profile/corpus/pools/semantic scores/gold/evaluator/eligibility/source-access records are frozen and a prereveal READY_FOR_REVEAL receipt is committed.
contamination_rule: If any denylisted target, development result, prior answer-bearing cohort, or post-reveal mapping is opened before freeze, stop and preserve CONTAMINATED_PRE_FREEZE. Do not relabel the run independent.
post_freeze_reveal: Return only the fresh-input identity, sealed-gold identity/hash, evaluator identity, and information-aperture receipt to the normal execution lane. That lane reveals frozen arms, runs and freezes outputs without opening gold, then reveals gold and evaluates.
nonclaims: This bootstrap does not qualify or promote the selector.
The target identity is not evidence of correctness.
Cohort specialty categories do not define gold usefulness.
READY_FOR_REVEAL authorizes execution only, not a selector disposition.
